zh: 未选工作区但对话用到本地目录或命令类技能时，会在消息内弹出「选择工作区」与「临时分配工作区（24小时后删除）」卡片，点选后即可在当前对话继续执行，不再出现「工具不可用」报错。
临时工作区在 24 小时有效期内会自动续用于同一对话的后续追问，到期后自动清理；普通对话也已拦截无法执行的本地命令技能，避免误调用。
新手引导第一步打完问题后会停住，点「发送」再看回答，能看清问的是什么。
引导走到数据抓取、数据导入、报表看板、一键催办、月报和大屏时，顶部有一条流程线标出当前在第几步；每个页面用编号标出 1–2 个重点按钮，卡片里配一句话说明。
新手引导里的工具页面会停一下后自动慢速向下滚动，到底后回到开头，高亮框和重点按钮标注跟着移动；滚动鼠标滚轮可以改为手动查看。
新手引导第一步可以用鼠标滚轮翻看输入框里的完整问题，发送后滚轮滚动对话区。
en: When a chat needs local workspace files or commands without a folder selected, an inline card now lets you either choose a workspace folder or allocate a temporary workspace (auto-deleted after 24h) and continue right away without tool-unavailable errors.

Temporary workspaces stay active for follow-up turns in the same chat during their 24h lifetime and are cleaned up automatically on expiry; workspace-only skills are also guarded in regular chats to avoid invalid command retries.
The first tour step now pauses after typing the question; select Send to see the reply, so you can read what was asked.

On the Data Capture, Data Import, Reports, One-Click Follow-Up, Monthly Report and Big Screen steps, a workflow line at the top shows where you are, and each page marks 1–2 key buttons with numbered highlights explained in the tour card.
Tool pages in the product tour now pause, then slowly scroll down and return to the top, with the highlight and key-button markers following along. Use the mouse wheel to scroll them yourself.
In the first tour step you can use the mouse wheel to read the whole question in the composer, and the conversation after it is sent.
